categories.description: Intro via N重量份(至M重量份)的X, N莫耳的X, N wt%的X — numeric composition prefix that _INTRO_PATTERN does not recognize
Intro via 至少N個X, 兩X, N個X — quantifier construction not in _INTRO_MULTI_QUANTIFIERS

Intro via inline 一X where the 一 is preceded by a content verb, conjunction, or other context that the current _INTRO_PATTERN left-anchor rejects. Fix shape is left-anchor denylist conversion (reject only preceding 該/所述/前述/其中一), NOT a verb allowlist. Generalizes V一X, 為一X, 輸出一X, 依據一X及一Y, etc.
Intro via X的Y or 形成於X的Y where Y is new and has no 一 prefix; HIGH RISK family because bare-noun intros are surface-form-identical to undefined references
Intro via 定義為X, 稱為X, 記為X, 表示為X — definitional verb prefix not recognized by _INTRO_PATTERN
Walker captures trailing character (particle/verb) into the parenthesized numeral group, e.g., 第一銜接部銜接(222) instead of 第一銜接部(222)
Walker parses 一個 as quantifier + noun start and eats the first character of a compound noun, e.g., 一個人化特徵 parsed as 一個 + 人化特徵 instead of 一 + 個人化特徵
Walker regex noun class fails on a non-CJK char after ordinal and truncates capture to bare 第一/第二

Walker extends capture past a legitimate noun boundary into a fresh N+V clause, e.g., 所述聚苯醚|成分包括 captured as 聚苯醚成分 when the correct boundary falls between 聚苯醚 and 成分 (成分包括 is a fresh N+V predicate). Fix shape is right-boundary lookahead for content-verb followers (包括/包含/是/為/用以/配置以/能夠).
Real drafting error in the source patent — walker is correctly flagging. MUST preserve (protect: true). The round-5 該使用者介面 canonical example lives here.
Term is cleanly introduced in a parent claim but the ancestor-chain walker fails to reach it (cross-category method→system, multi-parent BFS gap, etc.). Phase 9 territory.
全世界/地域-class idiomatic disjunction captures. Deferred to Phase 9 per CLAUDE.md known limitations.

Trailing verb character missing from _TRAILING_VERB_DENYLIST. The intro-side capture includes a trailing verb particle (e.g., 介 from 介於) that normalization fails to strip, causing a mismatch with the reference-side normalized form.

Greedy {2,12} noun capture extends through an embedded 一 that should be a separate intro site. The 一 character is not in the noun exclusion class, so the capture treats it as a regular noun char and swallows it. Fix: post-processing in extract_introductions_tw splits at non-word-internal 一 positions.

Greedy noun capture extends through an embedded reference-form prefix (所述/該/前述/該等/該些). The reference prefix chars are not in the noun exclusion class, so the capture treats them as noun chars. Fix: post-processing truncates at embedded reference prefixes.

Intro captures a term with paren numeral (e.g., 容置杯體(420)) but the reference omits the numeral (所述容置杯體). Prefix matching fails because the intro is LONGER than the reference. Fix: also register the paren-stripped form as an intro variant.
Cannot be categorized from the excerpt alone. Requires reading the full claim text to disambiguate. Schema v2 pass eliminated all v1 ambig entries; category preserved for future fixture additions.
Walker captured a wider span than the intended noun; legitimate intro exists in same claim with cleaner form. Mirror of CN Phase 8c walker_fp.over_capture.
Walker captured a sub-NP fragment; full noun phrase exists cleanly elsewhere. Mirror of CN Phase 8c walker_fp.fragment.
Walker left a trailing verb/particle attached to an otherwise clean noun. Mirror of CN Phase 8c walker_fp.trailing_residue.
Walker emitted a bare 第N ordinal as term; not a referable entity. Mirror of CN Phase 8c walker_fp.bare_ordinal.
Dependent-chain reference to a term introduced in a sibling claim; architectural (Option C territory). Mirror of CN Phase 8c walker_fp.cross_branch_sibling.
Walker failed to register an intro that exists in ancestor claim via a pattern the F-family does not cover. Mirror of CN Phase 8c miss_intro.coverage_gap.
Walker registered a list intro joined by 以及/和/與/及; needs post-split to register each element as its own intro. Mirror of CN Phase 8c miss_intro.conjunction_split.
Active label pending triage; must be resolved before a round can silence it.

round_history.name: r9_possessive_introduction
round_history.description: Added has_possessive_introduction_tw — new resolution arm for possessive bare-noun intros of the shape `(所述|前述|該)<X>之<Y>` where Y is intro'd as X's attribute. Bypasses the 4-char min-len gate because the structural pattern (definite-reference + 之 + noun) is unambiguous and short locative attributes (頂面/底面/側面/端面/頂端/底端) are exactly the target. Right-clean check intentionally skipped for this arm (verb-start chars like 外/突/包 aren't in the boundary set and would block legitimate intros of `所述X之頂面外露於...` shape). Closes user-attested issue #134 (claim 8 `所述第二波長發光元件之頂面外露於`). Ships in PR alongside CN R37 (parity port — mirror mechanism in has_possessive_introduction_cn for 的/之 genitives; same ordinal-led narrowing applied for cross-jurisdiction safety).

round_history.name: r30_plural_supplementary_symmetry_jiange_compounds_laizi_interior
round_history.description: Report #388 (多個/該些 plural bridge), report #399 (間隔), plus a cross-jurisdiction FP-direction parity gap found while draining. (b) CONDITIONAL QUANTIFIER RE-STRIP in normalize_reference_term. The leading-verb strip can EXPOSE a quantifier sitting behind the verb (所述根據多個X -> 多個X) that the single earlier pass could not see. Without it, (a) alone MANUFACTURED 1 FP because the reference keyed 多個X while the intro keyed X. Deliberately CONDITIONAL on the verb strip having consumed a prefix - an unconditional second pass would double-strip stacked quantifiers, which strip_leading_quantifier's non-iterative contract protects. (a)+(b) together measured 0 new fires. (c) 間隔<verb> COMPOUND TRAILING TOKENS. Bare 間隔 is deliberately ABSENT: 時間間隔 / 子載波間隔 / 第一子間隔 are real element names and a bare stop would be a FALSE NEGATIVE (measured: the naive bare stop cost 4 gold-legit FNs + 16 manufactured findings). Zero FN surface by construction, not merely a measured zero rate. (d) 來自 INTERIOR BOUNDARY. Pure coverb ('comes from') with no noun sense (the source noun is 來源, which does not contain 來自), so the cut is unconditionally FN-safe. CN has carried 来自 since R9 and TW never did - an FP-DIRECTION parity gap, the mirror of the standing FN-direction check. It had left the tw_copula_tiers fixture RED at HEAD with unresolved_new: 1 (輸入訊號來自一感測器模組), a pre-existing gate failure now reconciled. INTERIOR, not trailing: the capture continues into the object (一感測器模組), which an endswith pass can never reach. All 9 clean shifts come from this cut. WITHHELD this round: the #392 縱向 orientation-noun exemption. DR-1 measurement kills the class outright rather than merely under-evidencing it - exact 縱向方向 is gold-LEGIT in 8 findings and gold-FP in ~22, the same string with opposite labels in different drafts, so no term-keyed rule can separate them.
